10855-INTRODUCTION: Foreign Currency Positions
10856-The “Treasury Bulletin” reports foreign currency holdings of large 
10857-foreign exchange market participants. These reports provide information on 
10858-positions in derivative instruments, such as foreign exchange futures and 
10859-options that are increasingly used in establishing foreign exchange positions 
10860-but were not covered in the old reports. 
10861-The information is based on reports of large foreign exchange market 
10862-participants on holdings of five major foreign currencies (Canadian dollar, 
10863-Japanese yen, Swiss franc, pound sterling, and euro) and the U.S. dollar. 
10864-Positions in the U.S. dollar, which have been collected since January 1999, 
10865-are intended to approximate “all other” currency positions of reporting 
10866-institutions. U.S.-based businesses file a consolidated report for their 
10867-domestic and foreign subsidiaries, branches, and agencies. U.S. subsidiaries 
10868-of foreign entities file only for themselves, not for their foreign parents. 
10869-Filing is required by law (31 United States Code 5315; 31 Code of Federal 
10870-Regulations 128, Subpart C). 
10871-Weekly and monthly reports must be filed throughout the calendar year 
10872-by major foreign exchange market participants, which are defined as market 
10873-participants with more than $50 billion equivalent in foreign exchange 
10874-contracts on the last business day of any calendar quarter during the 
10875-previous year (end March, September, September, or December). Such 
10876-contracts include the amounts of foreign exchange spot contracts bought 
10877-and sold, foreign exchange forward contracts bought and sold, foreign 
10878-exchange futures bought and sold, and one half the notional amount of 
10879-foreign exchange options bought and sold. 
10880-A quarterly report must be filed throughout the calendar year by each 
10881-foreign exchange market participant that had more than $5 billion 
10882-equivalent in foreign exchange contracts on the last business day of any 
10883-quarter the previous year (end March, June, September, or December). 
10884-This information is published in six sections corresponding to each of 
10885-the major currencies covered by the reports. Tables I-1 through VI-1 present 
10886-the currency data reported weekly by major market participants. Tables I-2 
10887-through VI-2 present more detailed currency data of major market 
10888-participants, based on monthly reports. Tables I-3 through VI-3 present 
10889-quarterly consolidated currency data reported by large market participants
